title: kb_http read_chunked caps only chunk data at --max-body, so chunk extensions and trailers let one request make the server read far past the limit
goal: kb_http.Handler.read_chunked stops reading once the bytes it has read for one request, chunk-size lines, extensions and trailers included, pass --max-body plus a small fixed allowance, and answers 413 then; the drain on a refusal or 404 is bounded the same way; a test plants long chunk extensions and trailers; found by the SP-vpk5nrrc review
